answer: Two separate readers reaching the same answer is the whole of the check. One receipt settles the question, and the receipt is Scribe scroll roll mark lettered across the inkwell bench, written as each scroll roll is a measured sheet yield plus a calligrapher signature. Trust is sold per proof at 237 POA, and the farm's 336 proofs lock up 79632 POA it never sees again if it cheats. The farm's violet is its mask, its spiral its bribe, its dawn its alibi — and the panel checks the alibi first, because alibis break first.
